title: Double Drip Spearmint Menthol Nic Salt 10ml E-Liquid
description: Double Drip Spearmint Menthol delivers a fresh and breezy mint vape with a sweet herbal twist. Spearmint takes the lead with its light, cooling flavour and smooth, subtle sweetness, while the Menthol layer deepens the chill for a cooler, more refreshing finish. It’s a crisp, clean-tasting, lightly sweet vape that’s ideal for those who enjoy a bright mint flavour without the overpowering intensity of pure menthol. This nic salt e-liquid is blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio for excellent performance in MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices such as refillable vape pod kits , vape pens , and compact starter kits . The nicotine salt formulation provides fast-acting relief with a smoother, more comfortable throat hit than traditional freebase e-liquids. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Double Drip Nic Salts are available in a wide range of bold and satisfying flavour profiles to suit everyday vaping. Double Drip are one of the most celebrated and influential e-liquid brands in the UK and the masterminds of some of the most iconic vape flavours ever made. Vibrant, authentic, and highly inventive flavours are a hallmark of all Double Drip vape juices, and this newest collection of truly timeless flavours in smooth, satisfying nic salts won’t disappoint.
